summary: Iteration 8 (both) — Verified 'app doesn't work on phone' complaint and requested calendar font-size bumps. Native bundling is HEALTHY: `curl` against Metro for `platform=android` and `platform=ios` (Hermes) both returned HTTP 200 with ~10 MB bundles (1616 modules each) — no 'Unable to resolve module' errors. expo.err.log is empty. All new packages (expo-image-picker 17.0.11, expo-document-picker 14.0.8, expo-file-system 19.0.23 with legacy.ts shim, expo-sharing 14.0.8, expo-print 15.0.8) resolve correctly on native targets. Calendar font sizes confirmed via computed DOM styles on data-testid='day-2026-06-10' and 'day-2026-06-15': day number = fontSize 18px / fontWeight 700 (matches cellText spec), event name = fontSize 10px / fontWeight 600 (matches cellEventName spec). Both event names ('Wesele Nowaków' on 2026-06-10 and 'Party 22:00' on 2026-06-15) render inside their respective calendar cells and truncate to 1 line. Regression: login (test@eventa.pl / test123) → calendar tab → month nav Sierpień→Lipiec→Czerwiec 2026 → tap day-2026-06-10 shows Wesele Nowaków event card. All 5 tabs navigate cleanly (Kalendarz, Imprezy, Oferta, Pracownicy, Statystyki). New Oferta screen renders external images correctly (Dolina Przygód, 5 Urodziny packages + 12 Warsztaty). Zero console errors, zero page errors during 4-tab traversal. Backend: 70/70 tests PASS in 16.16s (iter1..iter7 combined in /app/backend/tests/). Conclusion: the 'nie działa na telefonie' complaint does NOT reproduce in the codebase — bundling, imports, and rendering are all healthy for Android/iOS/web. If user still sees crash on Xiaomi Expo Go, likely causes are (a) stale Expo Go cache on device (needs Clear Data), (b) old snapshot bundled before recent package additions, or (c) SDK 54 / Expo Go build mismatch. No code fix warranted from this side.
